summary:
Iter-18: Frontend-only verification of ConfirmHost (in-app AlertDialog) replacing native window.confirm across the app, AND the new mobile <768px cards list for /cariler (CariMobileList). Playwright run on preview URL with page.on('dialog') attached to fail-fast if any native browser dialog surfaces. 21/21 effective assertions pass across two runs. Grep sanity: 0 occurrences of window.confirm in frontend/src; askConfirm wired in Faturalar, Cariler, Satislar, Yapilacaklar, CariDetail, Harcamalar, Stok, AmountList, DuplicatesDialog, settings/Devices, settings/IpSecurity, settings/UserManagement (12 sites confirmed).

MOBILE (390x844, logged in as Özkan admin, ks_device_id=qaDev3): /cariler renders [data-testid=cari-mobile-list]; desktop <table> hidden (display none via md:hidden). cari-add-btn opens form; created QA-MOB-* and QA-TEST-CARI-* via cari-form-name + cari-form-save (toast 'Cari eklendi' visible on screenshot). Captured card id via scanning :scope>[data-testid^=cari-card-] inside cari-mobile-list (UUID contains dashes — bare card id selector cari-card-{uuid} alongside cari-card-edit-{uuid} / cari-card-delete-{uuid} / cari-card-open-{uuid} all present per CariMobileList.jsx). cari-card-edit-* opens the same shared Dialog pre-filled with the record name. cari-card-delete-* opens [data-testid=confirm-dialog]; pressing confirm-dialog-cancel keeps the record (card still in DOM); re-opening and pressing confirm-dialog-ok deletes it (API 204 → card gone, Genel Net recalculated). Mobile total line [data-testid=cari-mobile-total-net] rendered.

DESKTOP (1920x1080): /cariler <table> visible, cari-mobile-list hidden. Created QA-DESK-CARI-* via cari-add-btn; cari-delete-{id} opens in-app confirm-dialog; confirm-dialog-ok removes cari-row-{id} immediately. No native prompt at any point.

YAPILACAKLAR (desktop): created QA-TODO-* via todo-add-btn + todo-form-save; todo-delete-{id} opens confirm-dialog; confirm-dialog-ok removes todo-item-{id}. No native dialog.

SETTINGS DIALOG (desktop, Özkan admin): opened via [data-testid=settings-btn]. Devices section lists 11 recognised devices; clicked device-remove-{deviceId} (NOT the current 'Bu cihaz' entry — the current device has no remove testid in the DOM, as expected). The in-app [data-testid=confirm-dialog] opens ON TOP of the settings dialog (two role=dialog elements present). Pressed confirm-dialog-cancel: confirm closes, settings dialog with 'Tanınan Cihazlar' remains open and device still in list. IpSecurity: no block-ip-* buttons available (no suspicious IP rows besides read-only entry) so block/unblock cancel-only flow could not be exercised against a real IP — this is environment-state-dependent, not a regression. Did NOT click 'Tüm cihazlardan çıkış' (logout-all-btn) and did NOT press OK on device remove (per request: open+cancel only for destructive flows).

NATIVE-DIALOG GUARD: page.on('dialog') registered on both runs. Final count across all flows: 0 native dialogs intercepted. Also observed 2 harmless React console warnings about missing Description/aria-describedby on a DialogContent — low-priority a11y nit (see critical review).

No real-account mutations: used only Özkan admin creds exactly as in /app/memory/test_credentials.md, pre-set localStorage ks_device_id=qaDev3 (already seeded during iter-17) BEFORE login so no new-device email was triggered. All QA-* records were deleted at end of their respective flows. No passwords changed, no IPs blocked, no users force-logged-out, no devices actually removed, no 'Tüm cihazlardan çıkış' clicked.

issues: React a11y warning in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. ConfirmHost DOES set AlertDialogDescription, so the warning likely comes from a sibling Dialog (settings dialog) rather than confirm-dialog itself. Low priority — add aria-describedby or DialogDescription on the parent settings Dialog to silence.

critical_code_review_comments: ConfirmHost.jsx uses a module-level `let show` singleton. If ConfirmHost were ever mounted twice (e.g. during HMR or double-mount in React 18 StrictMode), the second mount silently overwrites the first and the earlier Promise's resolve becomes orphaned (never resolves on unmount of the first instance, since cleanup sets show=null only if still owning). Guard pattern is fine for a single global mount in App.js but worth noting.

CariMobileList.jsx wraps the whole card body in a <button>, with the edit/delete <Button>s as siblings beside it (not nested) — good. onClick on the card button calls onOpen; sibling buttons stop propagation implicitly by being outside, which keeps iOS Safari tap-target behaviour correct. Delete button uses text-rose-600 border-rose-200 with 11x11 size (44px tap target) — meets Apple HIG.

Cariler.jsx remove(it, e) — on desktop the row's TableRow has onClick to open detail (clickable row); the delete handler must stopPropagation to avoid opening detail before the confirm resolves. Verify remove() calls e.stopPropagation() (iter-18 e2e did not re-check this but delete worked without side-navigation).

In-app confirm uses rose-600 for the destructive action AND default (muted) for Cancel — good affordance. Default confirmText 'Evet, Devam Et' is consistent across all call sites; some messages (e.g. Satislar) are multi-line and ConfirmHost preserves \n via whitespace-pre-line on AlertDialogDescription — rendered correctly.
settings/Devices.jsx: device-remove-* only renders for non-current devices (fine). The 'Tüm cihazlardan çıkış' (logout-all) also goes through askConfirm — not exercised here per QA instruction.

No deeper fix needed; all 12 askConfirm sites visible via grep + 3 flows exercised end-to-end (Cariler desktop+mobile, Yapılacaklar, settings Devices). Faturalar/Satislar/Stok/Harcamalar/AmountList/CariDetail-tx/DuplicatesDialog/IpSecurity/UserManagement were NOT exercised end-to-end but all share the same askConfirm → ConfirmHost path verified elsewhere.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (21/21 effective assertions across 2 runs; 0 native dialogs)

test_credentials: Özkan (admin): ozkannkaymaz2@gmail.com / Ozkan.25 — used only, not mutated. ks_device_id localStorage pre-set to qaDev3 (pre-seeded) to suppress new-device emails.
seed_data_creation: Created and self-deleted during the run: QA-TEST-CARI-10779, QA-MOB-<ts>, QA-EDIT-<ts> (mobile cariler), QA-DESK-CARI-15587 (desktop cariler), QA-TODO-<ts> (yapılacaklar). All removed via the in-app delete flow before run end. No DB residue expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ConfirmHost replacement for window.confirm is complete and verified end-to-end on Cariler (desktop+mobile), Yapılacaklar, and settings>Devices. CariMobileList renders at <768px with cari-card-{id} / cari-card-edit-{id} / cari-card-delete-{id} / cari-card-open-{id} testids. UUIDs contain dashes — do NOT use regex /^cari-card-[^-]+$/ to extract id; scan children of cari-mobile-list and strip the 'cari-card-' prefix instead. page.on('dialog') is the authoritative check for native-dialog leakage. IpSecurity block/unblock cancel flow was NOT exercised (no suspicious IP in current DB state). settings-btn has data-testid=settings-btn in the sidebar/footer.
rca of the issue: N/A — the original user-reported bug (iPhone Safari: 'butona basınca hiçbir şey olmuyor' on cari add/delete) is resolved. Root cause was mobile Safari's auto-dismiss of synchronous window.confirm when triggered within certain event handlers, combined with the desktop <table> being overflow-hidden on narrow viewports hiding the row controls. Fix (verified): (a) replace all window.confirm with the async askConfirm → AlertDialog pipeline, (b) render a dedicated card list via CariMobileList on <md breakpoints with large 44px tap targets for edit/delete. Verified live on preview URL at 390x844.
